name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task states a conditional preference-free rule: if the key is picked up/carried, the door must also be open at some point. RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the correct hard rule for that no-timing 'if ... also' wording, and no unconditional goal is required, so the rule-only machine is valid.

texts: If the agent ever picks up/carrying the matching door key, the door must be open at some point in the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
